aiResearchSummary.text: Boundary Layer Technologies is focused on developing high-speed container ships utilizing hydrofoil technology. Their research includes systems for operating watercraft vessels, which involve communication units to receive position and velocity signals, and sensing units to determine relative positions. This technology aims to enhance the efficiency and speed of maritime transport by optimizing vessel formation and lift dynamics.
